name: BRO wrapper callback double-mint SolvBTC drain
summary: The BRO wrapper's mint() pulls the full ERC-3525 position in with safeTransferFrom, whose onERC721Received callback independently mints the same value before the outer mint() mints again, so the attacker looped burn-then-mint 22 times to compound 135.364250355343316230 BRO into 567,758,681.358134582535027962 BRO, traded 165,592,064.418235422750668661 BRO for 38.047405138108322251 SolvBTC from the treasury, and swapped that into 1211.054376965512754134 ETH in the same transaction.

loss.notes: Exact receipt accounting: one SolvBTC Transfer of 38.047405138108322251 from treasury 0xfb2dc2428b6c2fb149a3e6d658fdf979cc0afef9 to the attacker main contract, plus 22 BRO burns and 44 BRO mints evidencing the double-mint loop, all inside the single attack transaction. SolvBTC is valued at BTC parity via the 2026-03-05 CoinGecko daily close; the in-tx Uniswap conversion into 1211.054376965512754134 ETH corroborates the magnitude. The 402,166,616.939899159784359301 leftover BRO sent to the attacker EOA is unbacked supply, not counted. No attacker-supplied campaign inputs besides gas.

ageReset.description: Beacon-proxy BRO wrapper deployed pointing at beacon 0x031c97141721d8ceeb74f96684e4e712fcd6fefd, which still resolves to the vulnerable implementation and emits no upgrade events; the implementation runtime hashes identically at deployment and immediately before the incident.

sources.note: Anchor: 0x44e637c7d85190d376a52d89ca75f2d208089bb02b7c4708ad2aaae3a97a958d (block 24592074:1, 2026-03-05T15:09:35Z) is the single exploit transaction, sent by EOA 0xa407fe273db74184898cb56d2cb685615e1c0d6e, creating main contract 0xb32d3899 and looper 0x6aa78a9b. Receipt logs show exactly 22 BRO burns, 44 BRO mints, 22 safeTransferFrom callbacks, one 38.047405138108322251 SolvBTC treasury-to-attacker Transfer, and 1211.054376965512754134 WETH to the attacker, matching the published reconstructions. Deployer 0x55c09707fd7afd670e82a62faee312903940013e originated the wrapper through factory 0x4e59b44847b379578588920ca78fbf26c0b4956c (the immediate creation-trace creator) and is unrelated to the attacker; no compromised-key path is evidenced, the mints execute through the wrapper's own unguarded callback. Age: the beacon-proxy wrapper was deployed in 0xdb437f2070b8985d7064ad98a3f11b608a6eb3fa52b0f6d4d2ce6154af7bde8d at block 22515752:161 with hardcoded beacon 0x031c97141721d8ceeb74f96684e4e712fcd6fefd, whose implementation() still returns 0x15f7c1ac69f0c102e4f390e45306bd917f21cfcf with zero emitted logs; eth_getCode of the implementation at pre-exploit block 24592073 hashes 0xc033b419c5b8cd119ff9c548cfc317e25862d8587c13733c3324a700d37695a7 identically to head, giving 1772723375 minus 1747642475 equals 25080900 seconds.
